item: Row 309: a running app re-reads the country form on each new connection and refuses a half-migrated store
key_paths: src/database/country_form.py src/database/session.py src/database/read_snapshot.py src/config/kv_store.py src/backup/country_migration.py src/api/diagnostics/country_form.py tests/test_country_form_recheck_row309.py
summary: An app process alive with an empty pool (after a restore, repair, rebuild, unlock or panic) did not stop the country migration and afterwards wrote with its cached form: measured, de beside FRA under an alpha-3 marker, and after an interrupted run a resume that could never finish. Each new physical connection of the corpus and read-snapshot engines now reads the marker and journal through itself, drops a cached value that differs (the next read goes to the file and fails closed), moves the epoch so an earlier read is never cached, and refuses and closes the connection when the journal names an unfinished run, for reads as well as writes. A wrong passphrase given to migrate is refused by a read-only open first, so it no longer folds a crash-left -wal; only a held store or a read-only-only failure goes on to the read-write open. A start under a held store says the store is in use and names the 30-second wait instead of a damaged journal. Two-process tests on both legs.
